name: Shadow Puppet
summary: Shadow theatre on a lamp-lit cotton screen: translucent dyed-hide puppets carved like lace, pressed onto the cloth from behind so colour arrives as transmitted light, jointed figures on rods, plaques with glowing cut-out letters, a lacquer stage frame and a storyteller's placard.
suits: fables with good and bad actors

palette.use: the lamp-lit cotton screen at its brightest (lamp light through cloth, proposed hex)
cream placard text; the light seen through cut-out letters
the warm vignette at the cloth's edges (never grey)
vermilion dye: costume pieces, seals, borders, red light
indigo dye: water, sky, scattered blue light
gold dye; carved gold on the lintel
thin things that must read (3 px), rods
the lamp's light: warm, never white
the warm bloom round the hotspot
the red lacquer of the stage frame (proposed)
the black lacquer, the dark room (proposed)

type.case: caps on plaques (cut out of hide); sentence case on the placard
type.emphasis: a word on its own plaque; the plaque's red seal

banned: a black silhouette film: colour is the second protagonist
paper-cut (light comes through the hide, not around it), stained glass (no lead lines), flat vector cut-outs
particles for fire, smoke or water: they are carved pieces, swapped
morphing: pieces rotate on rivets, slide on rods, or are swapped
white or blue light, a grey vignette: every hue leans warm
pale thin pieces (they vanish): thin things are dark
a generic crossfade or digital wipe
